name: worldstream
description: A chat-driven, pixel-art living world for livestreaming on Kick.

scripts.dev: npm run -s assets && concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "vite build --watch" "WORLDSTREAM_STATE_DIR=state/main tsx watch src/server/index.ts"
scripts.build: npm run -s assets && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
